45° Incline Barbell Press.notes: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

45° Incline DB Press.notes: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

Cable Crossover Ladder.notes: Do one set with low cable position, one set with medium-height cable position, and one with a high cable position.

Pec Deck.notes: Full range of motion. Squeeze at the peak contraction.

Wide-Grip Pull-Up.notes: 1.5x shoulder width overhand grip. Slow 2-3 second negative. Feel your lats pulling apart on the way down.

High-Cable Lateral Raise.notes: Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight.

Pendlay Deficit Row.notes: Stand on a bumper plate. Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep!

Smith Machine Row.notes: Overhand grip, pull to lower chest. Control the negative.

Overhead Cable Triceps Extension (Bar).notes: Optionally pause for 0.5-1 second in the stretched aspect of each rep.

Bayesian Cable Curl.notes: If you have a left-right bicep size imbalance, do these 1 arm at a time, starting with the weaker arm.

Lying Leg Curl.notes: Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl.

Smith Machine Squat.notes: Set up your feet and bring them forward ~3-6 inches for a more upright squat with more quad tension.

Barbell RDL.notes: Stop about 75% of the way to full lockout on each rep to keep tension on the hamstrings.

Leg Extension.notes: Set the seat back as far as it will go. Grab the handles hard to pull your butt into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative.

Standing Calf Raise.notes: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Think about rolling your ankle on the balls of your feet.

Cable Crunch.notes: Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack.

Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown.notes: Do these with the handle more out in front of you, like a cross between pullover and pulldown. Focus on feeling your lats.

Chest-Supported Machine Row.notes: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top.

Chest-Supported T-Bar Row.notes: Flare elbows out and squeeze shoulder blades at the top. Control the negative.

1-Arm 45° Cable Rear Delt Flye.notes: Pause for 1-2 seconds in the squeeze of each rep. Contract the rear delts hard!

Machine Shrug.notes: Brief pause at the top and bottom of ROM. Think about pulling your shoulders up to your ears!

Cable Paused Shrug-In.notes: Pause at the top of each rep. Think about pulling your shoulders up and slightly in.

EZ-Bar Cable Curl.notes: Set up the cable at the lowest position. Maintain constant tension on the biceps. Slow, controlled reps!

Machine Preacher Curl.notes: Smooth, controlled reps. Mind-muscle connection with the biceps.

Barbell Bench Press.notes: Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on the chest and explode up on each rep.

Machine Chest Press.notes: Set up a comfortable position. Smooth, controlled reps with good mind-muscle connection.

Machine Shoulder Press.notes: Ensure that your elbows break at least 90°. Mind-muscle connection with your delts. Smooth, controlled reps.

Seated DB Shoulder Press.notes: Control the negative, press smoothly. Full range of motion.

Bottom-Half DB Flye.notes: All reps performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs.

Bottom-Half Seated Cable Flye.notes: Bottom half ROM only. Deep stretch in the pecs at the bottom of each rep.

Cable Triceps Kickback.notes: Can be done upright or bent over. When in full squeeze, your shoulder should be positioned back behind your torso.

Lying Leg Raise.notes: Perform these slowly, focus on keeping your lower back against the ground throughout the set.

Leg Press.notes: Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

Seated Leg Curl.notes: Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

Walking Lunge.notes: Take medium strides. Minimize contribution from the back leg.

Machine Hip Abduction.notes: If possible, use pads to increase ROM. Lean forward and grab the machine rails to stretch the glutes further.

Hack Squat.notes: Feet lower on platform for quad focus. Full depth with control.

Lean-Back Lat Pulldown.notes: Initiate the pulldown with straight posture. Lean back 15-30° to get mid-back more involved. Touch bar to chest.

Dual-Handle Lat Pulldown.notes: Neutral or semi-pronated grip. Focus on pulling through the elbows.

DB Concentration Curl.notes: Brace elbow against inner thigh. Slow, controlled reps with peak contraction squeeze.

Cable Rope Hammer Curl.notes: Neutral grip, slow negative. Focus on the brachialis and brachioradialis.

Leg Press Calf Press.notes: Full range of motion. Pause at the stretch. Control the movement.

EZ-Bar Skull Crusher.notes: Lower to forehead or just behind it. Control the negative, explode up.

Triceps Pressdown (Bar).notes: Keep elbows pinned at your sides. Full lockout at the bottom, controlled negative.

Ab Wheel Rollout.notes: Go as far as you can while maintaining a neutral spine. Control the entire movement.

Machine Crunch.notes: Round your lower back as you crunch. Focus on the contraction.

45° Hyperextension.notes: Round over at the top, extend through the hips. Control the negative.

Smith Machine Static Lunge w/ Elevated F.notes: Elevate front foot on a small platform for greater ROM. Keep torso upright.
